note: NOT lab-verified. Command shapes come from the FortiOS allowlist (specs/data/allowlists/fortios.json), the only FortiOS command evidence this repository holds; `verified` is false and output is labelled PREVIEW_SEED_UNVERIFIED. FortiOS leaves a sub-mode with `end`, not `exit`, so `mode_exit` is `end` — the executor inserts it whenever indentation drops and while unwinding a rollback. It commits on `end`, so `persist` is empty. DELIBERATELY OMITTED: `trunk`, `access` and `dhcp`. FortiOS switch ports are configured through `config switch interface` / hardware-switch profiles and its DHCP server through `config system dhcp server`, none of which is evidenced in this repository. Those nodes render NOT_MODELED and the run reports INCOMPLETE with the gap named rather than guessing (L01, T2).
